title: World GeoJSON feature properties
description: The `properties` object of every feature in a full-resolution file under data/. See docs/reference/properties.md. Previews carry a subset (shapeName, shapeISO, shapeType) and are not covered.

shapeISO.description: ISO 3166-2 code, or the national statistical code; "" when the upstream has none. Never an opaque upstream id.

adm1ISO.description: Key of the ADM1 unit containing this feature; present below ADM1 whenever the country publishes an ADM1. "unassigned" when the parent could not be determined.

parentISO.description: Key of the parent at the previous published level.

parentID.description: Feature id of the parent at the previous published level.

^src_.description: Verbatim upstream attributes, prefixed. `src_shape_id` is the geoBoundaries id.
